lines.zh: 八条细腿敲着地面前进
lines.en: Eight thin legs tap along the ground.
My frame scrapes with a faint sound.
No flesh on me; my steps are light.
I climb up along the wall's base.
My bone joints move in jerks.
I crawl from shadow into light.
The bones of my abdomen sway.
I sidle low across the ground.
There are remnants of webbing ahead.
I stop at each step, feeling the way.
My bones look pale in the moonlight.
I squeeze between blades of grass.
No breath, only the click of bone.
I crawl around to your other side.
Six legs carry me; two feel ahead.
I slip into a crack in the stone.
I hang on the wall without moving.
Dust has gathered in my joints.
I lift one leg, then set it down.
No eyes to blink.
I listen for tremors in the ground.

lines.zh: 整副骨架轻轻响了一下
lines.en: My whole frame clicks once.
I lie here without moving.
Even a little wind moves me.
I hang in place and wait.
A strand of silk quivers in the wind.
I halt at the edge of the shadow.
This body does not need to eat.

lines.zh: 我没有眼睛,但我知道你在
lines.en: No eyes, yet I know you are there.
I face you directly.
My bones shine pale in the light.
I raise two front legs.
You are larger than I expected.
I sense your body heat.
I watch you without moving.
My shadow has eight legs.
You take one step backwards.
Only a little wind between us.
One of my bones has cracked.
I pull back half a foot.
My frame tilts.
I reset my joints.
No pain, only misalignment.
That broke one of my legs.
I sway my abdomen.
The bones keep rattling.
I will crawl back bit by bit.
Do not tread on my frame.

lines.zh: 活物的热气，我骨头记得。
lines.en: My bones remember the warmth of the living.

lines.zh: 骨架不会饿,但本能还在
lines.en: Bone cannot hunger, but instinct remains.

lines.zh: 我用颚骨碰了碰那东西。
lines.en: I touch the thing with my jawbones.
Something living moves nearby.
I crawl along the scent.
This thing is warm.
Eight bone legs tap the ground around it.
I raise a leg to test it.
These bones cannot eat.
Still, I follow.
The impact knocks my frame aside.
I hook onto you and do not fall.
My bones ring hollow on impact.
Eight legs re-anchor.
I am far lighter than you.
Your armour is hard.
I slide down off you.
That did not crack my bones.
Do not crowd me; my legs will catch.
I pull back and reposition.
Bone fits into bone.

lines.zh: 我们没有血肉,也没有声音
lines.en: No flesh, and no voices.
I touch one foreleg to yours.
Two skeletons hang side by side.
This corner is quiet enough.
We keep to the same shadow.
Our joints click where they meet.
No warmth, but not alone.
The web will be mended soon.
If you stay, I will not move.
I hook it up with a leg.
Very light; no trouble at all.
I wedge it between my bones.
I cannot eat this.
I drag it along as I crawl.
It is stuck in my joint.
I hang it on the web.
It seems somewhat useful.
I wrap it in silk.
I will store it for now.
I have noticed you.
All eight legs tense.
You are moving more than before.
I flatten my frame even lower.
The rattle of my bones stops.
I am calculating your position.
This distance allows a lunge.
You will not hear me coming.
I turn toward you from the shadow.
You stepped on a strand of silk.
I shift half a step forward.

lines.zh: 猎物总是先动的那一方
lines.en: Prey always moves first.
I follow the tremors in the ground.
When you turn, I am on the other side.
My silk is already laid.

lines.zh: 你不看的时候我会更近
lines.en: I get closer when you are not looking.
I do not need to breathe.
My joints adjust their angles slowly.
You retreat, but the road ends.

lines.zh: 我的影子爬到你的脚边
lines.en: My shadow crawls to your feet.
My legs are all bare bone joints.
My bones keep clicking, faintly.
I climb to a higher spot.

lines.zh: 我的腿是骨头做的，踩得很响。
lines.en: My legs are bone, and they click loud.
My forelegs stab down.
Bone teeth bite in.
My frame bears down on you.

lines.zh: 这一下没有血肉的声音
lines.en: This blow makes no fleshy sound.
I crawl onto your back.
I hook into your armour's seam.
My leg tips tap down again and again.
I hang on and will not drop.
Broken bones do not matter to me.
I fling off and retreat to the shadow.
Bones assemble out of the soil.
Four legs rise first.
My frame takes shape in the moonlight.
My joints lock into place, one by one.

lines.zh: 开始有丝从腹部垂下来
lines.en: Silk begins to hang from my abdomen.
I crawl out of the hollow.
Thin tracks remain on the ground.
I shake out my frame.
Eight legs find their footing.
There is shadow here; good.
My bones char black.
A few of my joints scatter on landing.
Water floods my hollow frame.
The blast scatters my bones.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过了我的肋骨
lines.en: An arrow passes between my ribs.

lines.zh: 那股力量让骨头嗡嗡响
lines.en: That force makes my bones hum.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西,但骨架也在变虚
lines.en: I do not eat, yet my frame weakens.
Lightning runs through my frame.

lines.zh: 没有地面,我的腿抓不住
lines.en: No ground for my legs to grip.
